paragraphs.zh:
发明名称
一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺
paragraphs.en: Title of invention: A synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione (环磺酮)
paragraphs.notes: The newline in the zh field is a real structural break: 发明名称 is the INID sub-heading and the title itself is printed indented on the following line. The title characters are 环磺酮, three characters, verified at high magnification against the text layer; it is NOT the four-character 环磺草酮 used by CN104292137A. See the naming note on the (57) abstract for how 环磺酮 is identified as tembotrione.

paragraphs.zh:
摘要
本发明公开一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，包括：1)先加入2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、溶剂、催化剂、氢溴酸，然后滴加双氧水，反应后水洗、浓缩、重结晶，得到溴代物2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯；2)将溴代物、碱1、催化剂、溶剂、2,2,2-三氟乙醇进行反应，反应后过滤，水洗，浓缩；加入碱2、水，反应后酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得醚化物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸；3)将醚化物、催化剂、氯化亚砜、溶剂反应后脱尽溶剂；加入1,3-环己二酮、溶剂，滴加三乙胺；反应后加入丙酮氰醇，水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加溶剂进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得米黄色固体环磺酮。本发明提高中间体的收率，更环保、更安全、降低生产成本。
paragraphs.en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione (环磺酮), comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.
paragraphs.notes: The newline in the zh field is a real structural break: 摘要 is the INID sub-heading and the abstract body is printed as a separate indented block. The abstract body itself is printed across fourteen justified lines and is recorded here as one unwrapped string with nothing inserted at the joins. PUNCTUATION AS EXTRACTED: the text layer uses FULL-WIDTH '，' '；' '：' '、' '。' for prose punctuation and HALF-WIDTH '(' ')' ',' '-' inside Latin-script chemical names and locant strings ('1)', '2,2,2-', '1,3-', '(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)'). The printed page sets the full-width marks at a compressed advance width so they LOOK half-width; the text layer is authoritative and full-width is recorded. This is the opposite convention to CN104292137A's abstract, which genuinely used half-width prose punctuation throughout, so downstream passes must not carry that patent's convention across. GENERIC PLACEHOLDERS: the abstract never names the catalyst in any of the three steps, and it refers to two distinct bases only as 碱1 and 碱2 (base 1, base 2). Those identities are simply not on this page and have not been guessed. CHEMISTRY READ, all from the printed name and none from a drawing: step 1 is a benzylic bromination in which the bromine is generated in situ from 氢溴酸 (hydrobromic acid) plus 双氧水 (hydrogen peroxide, i.e. aqueous H2O2), not from elemental 溴素. Step 2 is Williamson etherification with 2,2,2-三氟乙醇 (2,2,2-trifluoroethanol) itself under base, then a separate saponification with 碱2 and water followed by acidification. Note that this step legitimately converts a methyl ester substrate into a free acid product, and the abstract DOES state the hydrolysis and acidification that account for it, so the ester-to-acid change here is NOT an internal inconsistency. Step 3 forms the acid chloride with 氯化亚砜 (thionyl chloride), couples it to 1,3-环己二酮 (1,3-cyclohexane-1,3-dione) with 三乙胺 (triethylamine) to give the enol ester, then adds 丙酮氰醇 (acetone cyanohydrin) to effect the rearrangement to the C-acylated triketone. 丙酮氰醇 is verified character by character against the text layer and reads acetone cyanohydrin, which IS the conventional cyanide-source catalyst for this rearrangement; it is not 氰基丙酮 (cyanoacetone). 1,3-环己二酮 carries its 1,3- locant explicitly here, unlike the bare 环己二酮 of CN104292137A. 米黄色 is rendered literally as 'rice-yellow', i.e. beige or cream. NAME NOTE: 环磺酮 is translated as tembotrione. That identification does not rest on the Chinese name alone; it follows from the route the abstract describes, namely a 2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl fragment coupled to cyclohexane-1,3-dione, which is the tembotrione skeleton. No structure is drawn anywhere on this page to confirm it, so the identification is from prose only. NO YIELDS, NO TEMPERATURES, NO TIMES and no molar ratios appear anywhere in the abstract.

discrepancies.text_says: The text layer encodes the 特殊普通合伙 brackets as half-width ASCII '(' ')', and encodes every abstract prose mark as full-width '，' '；' '：' '、' '。'. Per the born-digital rule the text layer wins for characters, so the zh fields carry the encoded forms. Downstream passes must not infer punctuation width from the pixels of this page, and must not carry CN104292137A's genuinely half-width abstract convention across to this patent.

discrepancies.what: The abstract names a catalyst in all three steps and two distinct bases, but identifies none of them. Recorded so the gap is visible rather than being silently filled later.
discrepancies.drawing_says: (no drawings on this page - this is a text-internal omission, recorded here so it is not lost)
discrepancies.text_says: Step 1 lists 催化剂 with no identity; step 2 lists 碱1 and 催化剂 and later 碱2; step 3 lists 催化剂. The abstract also gives no yield, no temperature, no reaction time and no molar ratio anywhere. All of these must come from the description pages (p03 onward) and none of them has been inferred here.

notes:
PROVENANCE. CN109678767A is born digital and carries a real embedded text layer on all 11 pages. Every zh field on this page was taken verbatim from that text layer, character for character, including its full-width punctuation and its ideographic spaces. No Chinese character on this page was transcribed by a model from pixels. The image was read independently and used for layout only: block positions, which lines belong together, the two-line wraps in the (71) address, the (72) inventor list and the (74) agency name, the vertical left-margin sidebar, and confirmation of what is graphic rather than text. Where image and text layer disagree, layout follows the image and characters follow the text layer; every such disagreement found is listed in discrepancies.

LINE JOINING. The only editorial act applied to zh is joining printed line wraps with nothing inserted between them. Real structural newlines are kept as \n and occur in exactly three fields: (51), (54) and (57). Extraction line 20 is a lone ASCII space, an empty gutter line between the IPC block and the (54) block; it carries no content and is not recorded as a paragraph.

DRAWINGS. There are NO chemical drawings on this page: no structure, no scheme, no fragment. This was checked across the whole page at magnification, including the blank lower region. The only two graphics are the CNIPA emblem and the QR code, both listed under illegible as non-transcribable graphic devices. The drawings array is therefore empty by observation, not by omission. The lower roughly 45 percent of the page, below the end of the abstract, is entirely blank apart from the vertical left-margin sidebar. That is the genuine end of the page and not damage.

PAGE LABEL. page_label is null because this is the bibliographic front page and CNIPA prints no 权利要求书 N/M页 or 说明书 N/M页 running header on it. This matches the convention used for the front page of the reference run.

CONFIDENCE. page_confidence is high. Nothing on the page is unreadable, the character-level content comes from the publication's own text layer rather than from pixel reading, and the two unreadable regions are a QR code and a logo, neither of which carries transcribable text. No chemical structure had to be interpreted anywhere on this page.
